text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: inference-service v3.5.0 -> ap-southeast-1 (canary=2%). config flags: kms_mode=auto, secrets_provider=secrets-manager.

emily: Getting paged [31mURGENT[0m [31m5xx spike[0m from inference-api on the canary. Several tenants seeing timeouts.

sam: digging in logs. Seeing repeated decrypt failures: `InvalidCiphertextException: The ciphertext was encrypted under a different key` from the KMS client. Example log: 
```
2026-05-10T03:14:21Z ERROR inference.runner: Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: The provided ciphertext cannot be decrypted with the current key.
2026-05-10T03:14:21Z WARN inference.gateway: upstream request failed: 502
```

raj: context - infra rotated a CMK yesterday to a new symmetric key id `arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:111222333:key/new-symm-2026` but an automation job also created an asymmetric key for signing and updated the alias to point to the new key. Secrets manager was updated with the alias, not the exact key id. The service expects a symmetric key for decrypt. Looks like alias switched to an asymmetric key by mistake.

emily: pausing rollout & aborting canary promotion now. executing helm rollback for canary subset.

ops-lead: Paused. Feature flag `kms_mode` set to `legacy` to force old decrypt path that uses the previous key and local secret. Flag flipped by ops-lead.

infra-ci: Confirmed automation log: secrets-update job returned 200 but the key type validation failed earlier and a follow-up job swapped alias to the asymmetric key. Job: https://ci.redwood/infra/1245/logs. Root cause: key rotation pipeline incorrectly allowed `KeySpec=RSA_2048` for the alias update.

sam: immediate mitigation plan: 1) abort canary promotion (done), 2) flip FF to legacy (done), 3) revert alias to previous symmetric CMK `arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:111222333:key/prev-symm-2025` and update Secrets Manager to reference explicit key id, 4) redeploy corrected canary with explicit key id (not alias), 5) run smoke tests.

emily: customer impact: ~1.5k failed requests in last 10m; affected tenants include BetaLabs and two small customers reporting 502s. No indication of data leakage. CS alerted.

cs-team-bot: CS draft requested. Suggest: quick apology, state limited scope, mitigation steps performed, timeline for full fix, link to support ticket. Tagging @cs-team for review.

raj: hands-on commands I'm running now: 
```sh
# revert alias to previous symmetric key
aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/inference-kms --target-key-id arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:111222333:key/prev-symm-2025
# update Secrets Manager explicit mapping to key id (avoid alias for now)
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id prod/inference/kms-key --secret-string '{"kms_key_id":"arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:111222333:key/prev-symm-2025"}'
```

sam: redeploying canary with fixed env injection: converted helm chart so KMS_KEY_ID uses `.Values.kms.explicitKeyId` and added a CI assertion `secretsmanager:exists` before promoting.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-1012 (severity: sev2). Pager suppressed after FF and rollback.

ops-lead: Handoff to night oncall @raj at 04:00 UTC. Handoff checklist: 1) verify alias points to symmetric key and decrypt logs clear for 30m, 2) ensure Secrets Manager contains explicit key id, 3) confirm error-rate < 0.1% for 30m, 4) follow up on infra pipeline key-spec validation fix.

raj: acknowledged. created follow-up ticket ops/INC-2026-1012-followup and infra PR to validate key spec and prevent alias swaps: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/957. Also adding an enforcement check in rotation job to disallow RSA/EC for decrypt-use aliases.

emily: summary for postmortem: cause: automation rotated key and alias pointed at an asymmetric key; service expects symmetric CMK for decrypt; mismatch caused InvalidCiphertext -> 5xxs. Mitigations: immediate rollback/pause, feature-flag fallback, alias reversion, Secrets Manager explicit key id, chart+CI changes, infra pipeline hardened. Postmortem scheduled in two business days.

deploy-bot: Metrics: canary error-rate dropped back to baseline after alias revert and Secrets update. Canary aborted.

emily: leaving channel to draft incident note and customer comms. tagging owners for postmortem. handing to night oncall. :hand: 

raj: will monitor overnight and post status updates here.
